newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romanian leu closes slightly firmer.
newsitem.headline: Romanian leu closes slightly firmer.

text.p: 1630 GMT - The Romanian leu closed slightly firmer at 7,055/65 to the dollar against its opening of 7,060/80 on Thursday as supply outpaced demand in sluggish trading.
* Traders said they expected little change in the leu on Friday.
* Latest central bank data put interbank volume at $44.2 million on Wednesday, when overall trading was $95.5 million.
* Short-term rates hovered around 93 percent on a money market replete with leu funds.
* The leu's retail rates lingered around 6,850/7,000 to the dollar.
